title: CogniCore session handoff
description: cognicore.handoff/v1: what one agent saves (cognicore_save_session) so another agent, in any client, can resume the work (cognicore_resume_session). Built without LLM calls; exact values are copied verbatim and detected secrets are redacted.

agent.description: Which agent saved it, e.g. claude-code, cursor. Empty if not given.

client.description: Which client/app, e.g. claude-desktop, vscode. Empty if not given.

message_count.description: null for sessions migrated from pre-v1 storage

migrated.description: true when rebuilt from a pre-v1 session's memory rows

goal.description: What the work is for. Explicit goal from the agent, else extracted.

current_state.description: Where the work stands: latest status statements, or the agent's own summary.

decisions.description: In conversation order. Resume shows the most recent first.

why.description: Reason, when stated (text after because / since / so).

status.description: rejected = an approach that was tried or considered and dropped

key_facts.description: Other statements worth keeping, verbatim. Statements with exact values come first.

exact_values.description: Every id, version, hash, path, number, error code, env var name, date, URL... seen, verbatim and de-duplicated.

files.description: Files, paths, URLs and domains touched or mentioned.

context.description: The sentence just before the code block.

environment.description: Fingerprint supplied by the saving agent. Compared with the resuming agent's environment to produce warnings. Non-Python runtimes go in dependencies, e.g. {"node": "20.11.1"}.

redactions.description: How many secret-like values were replaced with [REDACTED:<kind>].
